title: China's 561 km Sky Road Is Open Just 4 Months a Year | China Travel Expert
description:
The Duku Highway (独库公路) runs about 561 km across the Tianshan mountains in Xinjiang, from Dushanzi in the north to Kuqa in the south — and it's only open to traffic from roughly June to early October. The rest of the year, snow closes it completely.

It was built between 1974 and 1983, and 168 soldiers died during construction. About a fifth of it sits on high-mountain permafrost and a third clings to cliffs, crossing several rivers and snow peaks. Drivers say you can pass "all four seasons in a single day" along the route.

🧭 Expert Tip: If it's on your list, aim for late summer through the end of September — the road usually shuts for winter in early October and doesn't reopen until June. Always check the current traffic-control notice before you go.

独库公路:561公里,一年只开4个月,一天走过四季。
